svg.text: Not time trouble — the engine had four times the clock it needed.
wins a pawn, throws the win
The search has to out-depth its own evaluation by 235 cp.
One second does not buy that. The search was never the problem —
the evaluation was wrong in exactly the position that decided the game.
Three candidate fixes tried against it. All three left the move unchanged.
